rule: This is a total launch cap, not monthly authorization. Any charge taking cumulative launch spending above $50 requires explicit user approval. The $19 Shopify registration invoice is paid. Staging compute is stopped between attended tests; no new hosting subscription was purchased.

staging.notes: Metered usage before plan credits, not an invoice or confirmed card charge. Usage can lag; bucket charges are not itemized. Compute is stopped after the attended merchant-agreement installation, PDF, uninstall and recovery rehearsal. All eleven merchant-data tables are empty, the temporary restore copy is removed, and the test Flow remains disabled. The private service volume and encrypted recovery bucket remain retained and metered. recoveryBucketBytes is the older measurement at recoveryBucketBytesCheckedAt. Reconcile actual launch charges against the $50 total cap.
